items.title: Steve Gilmore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Delaware Water Gap, PA, November 8, 1999
items.q: Bill Charlap and I... have a duo and work together as a duo... Besides that he’s a very good friend of mine.

ctx.x: There’s not too many musicians I play with in this area other than Phil, actually very little in this particular area. There’s very little work. But I did work, there was a little gig, a jazz trio guitar gig that I worked last night with a wonderful guitarist, Bill Washer, who lives in this area. And other than that, I work here at the Deerhead Inn. But generally I don’t work with people who live in the area. Bill Charlap and I, the wonderful pianist with Phil Woods at this particular time, have a duo and work…
Do you do all your own business?
